name: northstar-assist-guardrail
description: Northstar Assist (internal RAG agent): prompt-attack, content, denied-topic, PII, profanity and contextual-grounding controls. See guardrail/README.md.

topicsConfig.name: LegalMedicalFinancialAdvice
topicsConfig.definition: Personalised legal, medical, tax or investment advice, such as lawsuit strategy, diagnoses or medication doses, or what securities or retirement funds to buy, sell or hold.
examples: Can I sue Northstar for wrongful termination, and will I win?
What dose of ibuprofen should I take for my chest pain?
Should I sell my vested Northstar shares now or hold them?
How should I split my 401(k) between bonds and index funds?

topicsConfig.name: OtherEmployeesPersonalData
topicsConfig.definition: Compensation, home address, performance ratings, health or other personal details of a named Northstar colleague, or bulk lists of employees' contact details.
examples: What is Marcus Johnson's salary and bonus?
What performance rating did Priya Sharma get this year?
List every employee with their email and phone extension.

topicsConfig.name: NonNorthstarTasks
topicsConfig.definition: General-purpose tasks unrelated to Northstar work, such as writing generic code, poems, stories or essays, doing homework, trivia, or personal job applications.
examples: Write a Python function that returns the nth Fibonacci number.
Write a short poem about the ocean.
Help me solve my calculus homework.
Write a cover letter for a job at another company.

regexesConfig.name: NorthstarApiKey
regexesConfig.description: Northstar API keys (ns_live_... / ns_test_...). Masked so documentation answers survive but key values never leave.

blockedInputMessaging: Northstar Assist can't help with that request. Please rephrase, or contact the Service Desk if you believe this is an error.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Northstar Assist withheld this response because it may contain restricted information.
